title: Product attributes
description: Define product options such as size, color, and material.

help.title: About product attributes
help.overview: Attributes are the options your products come in, such as Size or Color, with their values (S, M, L). Variants are built from them.

sections.title: Each attribute
items: Name is required; add up to 50 values.
Used for variants: the attribute makes product variants, one for each combination of values.
Visible on product page shows it in the product's details; it doesn't change prices.
Position sets its order on the product page and in the variant picker.
An attribute used by a variant can't be deleted; remove it from those variants first.
